title: Adaptive Circuit Breaking and Load Shedding in Reactive Microservices Using JVM Runtime Telemetry — Replication Package
description: Replication package for TACL: reactive Netty gateway, Tomcat/HikariCP downstream service, 2M-row PostgreSQL workload, 138 closed-loop and 304 open-loop runs, plus extended 45-run 4-shard validation (n=5 bounded bootstrap CIs, offered-rate load sweep, and 2-replica round-robin fleet with max/mean telemetry aggregation).
